title: From a Fullerene to a Fair Die: DICTO's Hollow-Straw Transformation of C116 into Minana #377
description: Paper #124. DICTO's Hollow-straw transformation keeps both ends fixed: the fullerene C116 and the fair die Minana #377. Every face plane of the fullerene moves along a straight path (in the coordinates a with plane a·x = 1) into the plane of its partner face of the die, and the solid enclosed by the moving planes grows from the fullerene into the die through one layer of Scutoid-Frusta. The path is certified exactly in Q(sqrt5): the pieces stay nested throughout, and the face pattern changes by exactly 18 neighbour swaps, 6 at one moment and 12 at another. A lemma shows that the layer is nested exactly when every intermediate solid lies inside the die. Further fullerene and die pairs are tested numerically, and the paper states which results are exact and which are numerical.
